status: Implemented; recorded focused/client evidence retained and final full/native regressions passed. See the stated verification scope.

festive.power: Original fixed xmas channel, real 1000-ohm load per fixture, cached closest matching lamp-supply handle until it disappears, including disabled-nearer-provider behavior. Original festive lookup has no ordinary lamp-supply range cutoff. All demand is billed through the actual supply resistor, with no ideal voltage source at a decoration.
festive.light: Source floor(12*(abs(V)-180)/20*16), clamped 0..15; renderer enabled only above level four. Actual carrier block-state emission with loaded-chunk stale-light recovery and real light removal checks.
festive.visuals: All original OBJ groups and source offsets/rotations, alternating tree strips over a 21-tick cycle and emissive star, candle base/dark lamp/transparent glass, wall string light mesh. Source descriptors inherit voltageLevelColor=None and do not override held rendering, so original flat inventory and held artwork is retained.
festive.placement: Original nineteen tree ghost cells, ownership and rotation; tree/candle require an opaque floor or hopper, string lights need any horizontal opaque wall and no floor. Support loss removes the complete reserved assembly.
festive.crafting: Original December-only recipes: two strings of lights and spruce sapling -> tree; glass panes/200V LED bulb/iron ingots -> candle; 200V LED bulb and string -> two string lights. general.enableFestiveItems defaults true, controls creative visibility and gracefully suppresses recipes when disabled. IDs remain registered for saved worlds.

incubator.power: 50 V / 50 W, actual 50-ohm resistor and .0125-ohm terminal resistance. Four floor power edges. Empty slot has high impedance. Random 10000..20000 J remaining hatch cost persists through saves/rebuilds and advances only from actual paid resistor work.
incubator.hatching: One real egg consumed only after successful insertion of one real baby chicken aged -24000; new original random energy cost after hatching. No forced chunk loading. Paid work is retained while entity insertion is cancelled.
incubator.automation: Original one 64-egg slot, input from all six sides and no automated extraction. GUI/manual extraction remains possible. Invalid non-egg insertion is rejected consistently, correcting original automation bypass of its GUI egg filter.
incubator.protection: Original nominal-voltage watchdog, first-excursion joker, random .5..1.5 overflow integration, 65 V magnitude boundary and 12.5 V-second capacity; original machine blast strength three.
incubator.visuals: Original main/lampf/lamp groups, voltage-squared orange transparent lamp glow, rotating original egg item, original flat inventory icon plus descriptor's held 3D mesh.
incubator.crafting: Original IGG / E G / CII using iron ingots, glass panes, small 50V tungsten heating element and Cheap Chip.

tests.incubator: IncubatorGameTests.kt: three real Minecraft cases for paid saved hatching/outage, actual sided egg automation/crafting/reload and real overvoltage destruction

lighting_lifecycle.recovery: Ordinary queued vanilla section/source and block checks only; whole-chunk lightChunk fallback removed. Pending partial lighting batches are scheduled after the simulation tick using tryScheduleUpdate.
lighting_lifecycle.expiry: Original five-tick emitted-light leases. Loaded projections are tracked by block-entity identity and expire even when ordinary block/entity ticking stops. Zero emission propagates for two ticks before the invisible carrier is removed; unloaded chunks are never forced for cleanup.
lighting_lifecycle.evidence: Twelve repeated real-brightness/expiry cases, neighboring real vanilla torch preservation, and a real FULL-only level-33 chunk all passed after saving/reloading the clean profile.
lighting_lifecycle.older_profile: The old mixed gametest-bcce-wireless-final profile retains failure evidence, including inconsistent light data observed during the abandoned whole-chunk relight experiments. No personal Minecraft world was used.

bcce_visuals.note: The artifact still prints its unregistered-holder-generation warning; the read-only client audit verifies every actual atlas texture and cached holder reference, including all 194 warning entries.

finalRegression.scope: All required cases passed. Existing per-device focused/client evidence and its limits remain authoritative; this field does not claim every configuration was exercised.
